description: As a remote sensing scientist, your lab has received two separate Sentinel-2 spectral band files — sentinel2_B04_red.tif containing visible red wavelength data and sentinel2_B08_nir.tif containing near-infrared data — located in /home/ga/snap_data/. These two files need to be combined into a single multi-spectral product for analysis. Open both files in SNAP Desktop, merge them into a unified product that contains both spectral bands, and derive a vegetation characterization index from the combined data. Save the integrated product in BEAM-DIMAP format and export as GeoTIFF to /home/ga/snap_exports/.
